title: NEB Class 12 Mathematics — Differentiation — 2021
origin: curated NEB-pattern set for class-12 differentiation

questions.question: Differentiate with respect to $x$: (a) $y = x^3 \sin x$, (b) $y = \frac{e^x}{x^2 + 1}$.
questions.solution:
(a) Product rule $(uv)' = u'v + uv'$ with $u = x^3$, $v = \sin x$: $dy/dx = 3x^2\sin x + x^3\cos x = x^2(3\sin x + x\cos x)$.
(b) Quotient rule $(u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v^2$ with $u = e^x$, $v = x^2+1$: $dy/dx = \frac{e^x(x^2+1) - e^x(2x)}{(x^2+1)^2} = \frac{e^x(x^2 - 2x + 1)}{(x^2+1)^2} = \frac{e^x(x-1)^2}{(x^2+1)^2}$.

questions.question: If $x = at^2$ and $y = 2at$, find $dy/dx$. Then find the second derivative $d^2y/dx^2$.
questions.solution:
Parametric differentiation: $dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt)$. $dy/dt = 2a$, $dx/dt = 2at$, so $dy/dx = 2a/(2at) = 1/t$.
For the second derivative, differentiate with respect to $x$: $d^2y/dx^2 = \frac{d}{dx}(1/t) = \frac{d}{dt}(1/t)\cdot\frac{dt}{dx} = (-1/t^2)\cdot\frac{1}{2at} = -\frac{1}{2at^3}$. (This is the tangent slope behaviour of the parabola $y^2 = 4ax$.)
